title: Serializing Multi-Byte Integers to Big/Little-Endian Buffers
description:
Writing multi-byte values into transmission buffers safely using byte shifts prevents architecture portability bugs.

### Requirements:
1. `write_be16(buf, val)`: Big-endian 16-bit.
2. `write_be32(buf, val)`: Big-endian 32-bit.
3. `write_le16(buf, val)`: Little-endian 16-bit.
hint: Serializing bytes explicitly eliminates compiler padding and architecture alignment requirements.
